## Recall · The question and the data

a) What must a project question be?
b) Which data must you never collect?
c) What makes a list an Excel table?

::: {.answer}
a) clear, and the data can answer it
b) names, phone numbers or marks of other people
c) Ctrl + T
:::

## Recall · The summary and the report

a) Which tool gives the total of each item in one table?
b) Which chart compares the items?
c) How does each part of the report start?

::: {.answer}
a) a PivotTable with Rows Item
b) a column chart
c) with a Heading 1
:::

## Summary

- The project is one topic and three files: a data sheet, a report and a short talk.
- It starts with one clear question that the data can answer.
- No personal data of other people goes into the project.
- The data sheet has a table, a formula, a PivotTable and one chart with a title.
- The report starts with five Heading 1 parts, and every AI number is checked.

## Results of the worksheet

Which results do you have in your table?

::: {.reveal}
- Experiment 1: a clear question that the data can answer, and no personal data of other people.
- Experiment 2: a table with a total row, a PivotTable whose Grand Total equals it, and a chart with a real title.
- Experiment 3: five Heading 1 parts, the chart under Results, and every AI number checked.
:::
